Name: (CP) Another Character Redesign (Maru)
Author: redriott
Description:
[center]﻿this is a simple content patcher mod that makes maru have dreads along with other design tweaks, since thats how i draw her n i think its cute :P
it also gives her scrubs instead of the white nurse dress thing cus i think the scrubs look better :V
whether or not i make similar mods for other characters is rlly up in the air tbh but if i do then i might end up making a big bundle of em like all the cool modders do

to install:
1. install [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]content patcher[/url]﻿
3. follow the same steps used to install content patcher to install this mod (i.e unzip the file into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder)

[s]i may update this with seasonal variants later if i feel like it
[/s][color=#cc4125]ADDED SEASONAL VARIANTS[/color] 04/29/19
seasonal variants require tanpoponoko's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2449]seasonal villager outfits[/url]﻿! see included readme for install instructions

lmk if u spot any issues/graphical errors/oversights/etc.!

(the map recolor seen in the banner is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2050]eemie's just a new map recolor[/url]﻿!)[/center]
